concept.title: Volunteering and community involvement
concept.shortdesc: Finding and taking on volunteer roles and getting involved in local community activities and services.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Information and advice on finding, applying for and arranging volunteering roles.
: Taking on volunteer roles or working alongside volunteers, with some befriending and volunteer-matched visits.
: Help to connect with, be directed to and get involved in local community groups, services and opportunities.
: General community-based activities, projects and events that people join, including at home or in a community room.
